issue.title: test_countdown_tick_repaint_leaves_no_strip_or_fifocache_garbage finds 74 Strip / 518 FIFOCache garbage under the loaded full lane, passes isolated
issue.description: Countdown-tick GC flake found by the sase-1vn.4.1 land agent. See the flake report below.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Found by the sase-1vn.4.1 land agent during `sase tool run check` abc537ee968537f8f05a7176a3b27344 (2026-11-28). The scoped lane escalated to the full suite: 63,959 passed, 1 failed. The tree was master a5fde6cd11 plus the landing's recovery-submission symbol cleanup and epic_liveness test additions, and that diff touches no TUI code. The test file is unchanged since cdad9024a9 (2026-11-21).

Failure at tests/ace/tui/test_countdown_tick_gc.py:90:

    assert counts.get(_STRIP, 0) == 0
    AssertionError: assert 74 == 0
    Counter({'rich.segment.Segment': 522, 'textual.cache.FIFOCache': 518, 'builtins.dict': 518, 'builtins.list': 148, 'builtins.tuple': 74, 'textual.strip.Strip': 74})

Three serial isolated reruns on the same tree passed (about 4.4 s each). Observed fail rate: 1 of 4 runs, only in the loaded full parallel lane; it did not reproduce serially.

Possibly related (unproven): the sase-1v2 evidence notes that the Textual thread-worker `active_worker` context var can pin finished-worker cycles in a pooled asyncio executor thread until a later worker overwrites it. That would let cross-test garbage appear under SAVEALL, and the note names this test's Strip/FIFOCache failures as a possible case of the same mechanism.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (scoped lane escalated to full suite under load); serial: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_countdown_tick_gc.py::test_countdown_tick_repaint_leaves_no_strip_or_fifocache_garbage

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1vn.4.1 land agent's check failed only this unchanged TUI GC node under full-lane load and it passed 3/3 isolated; no task tracks this node.
